nodes.name: 闩上的门
who: the guest prince who holds the door
nodes.light: a single small oil lamp held low by the visitor throwing warm gold up onto both faces, against the cool blue-white of a summer night coming through the open door behind him
nodes.camera: from inside the room, low, just behind the queen's shoulder, looking across her at the prince standing in the doorway; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a summer night in the guest room of a small mountain king's palace, the room bare and plain: whitewashed stone walls, a narrow bed with a wool blanket, a long white-ash spear leaning against the door frame. We look from inside the room. In the near left foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, seen from behind at three-quarter, stands a young queen of twenty-five who has just stepped in: long flaxen hair loose down her back, grey eyes like a lake before rain that we see in one cheek and one eye, a long dark travelling cloak closed from the throat to the floor over a high-necked wool gown, and in her raised hand a small oil lamp whose flame lights her face from below. Her face is lovely and wet-eyed, her lips parted as if about to speak. In the middle of the picture, at arm's length from her, the guest prince stands in the open doorway. Hipono is twenty-one, lean and straight-backed, long pale-gold hair tied behind his head with a cord of braided horse mane, amber eyes open and level, a broken bowstring wound round his left wrist. He wears a plain linen shirt and leather trousers, no boots. He has pushed the heavy door wide with his right hand and stands beside it, his left hand open and held out toward the corridor in a courteous, final gesture, his face calm and proud and a little pale, his eyes not on her lamp but on her face. Behind him the stone corridor runs away to the right, with a torch bracket, a bolt on the inside of the door standing out dark against the wood, and far down the passage, small, a waiting maid in a grey dress stands with her hands folded, looking at the floor. Moths turn around the lamp flame and a few large out-of-focus dust motes drift across the near corners.
nodes.note: 主会话改：王后夜里来客房，衣着改成裹严的斗篷和高领长裙，不写睡袍。

nodes.name: 金笼头
who: the horseman with the golden halter
nodes.light: bright cold-gold sun from the upper right on white feathers and golden metal, with deep violet-blue shadow in the canyon below
nodes.camera: from the rope-bridge's far end, low, looking up across the bridge at the rearing horse against the sky; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: midday high above a vast stone canyon whose floor is lost in blue haze. Slabs of pale rock float in the air at all heights, trailing a few stones and roots below them, with rope bridges slung between them. In the upper middle of the picture, the highest floating slab carries a small spring that runs silver over its lip. On that slab a huge snow-white horse, taller than any steppe horse, rears with both wings fully spread to a span of three men, every feather clean white without a single dark one; its front hooves strike at the air and its mane streams. Over its head a new golden halter has just been thrown from behind, the gold catching the sun in a hard line, and the reins run down into the fists of the young horseman clinging to them. Hipono is on the slab at its edge, leaning back with all his weight on the reins, long pale-gold hair torn out of its cord by the wing-wind, amber eyes narrowed, jaw set, a broken bowstring on his left wrist. The slab has begun to sink: its underside shows cracked rock and hanging roots, and a loose rain of pebbles falls away from it. In the near right foreground, on the last planks of the high rope bridge, a very small dwarf woman with copper-red hair in a dozen thin braids and pumice beads at their tips is braced with both feet on the boards, one fist wrapped round a small pale pendant of pumice at her neck, the other arm flung up, and she is heaving upward with her whole body; the loose pebbles under the slab are rising back toward it and the stretched bridge ropes are bar-straight. A thin line of red runs from her nose over her lip, and her bright green eyes are shut tight. White wing feathers and drifting pebbles hang large and out of focus across the corners.

nodes.name: 三道光
who: the rider on the white horse
nodes.light: three coloured lights from below, red from the left, violet from the middle and teal from the right, through white steam, against the pale gold sky above
nodes.camera: high above and slightly behind the rider's shoulder, looking steeply down at the three heads through the steam; strongly tilted, a hint of speed
nodes.text: Scene: the third day of the hunt at the fork on the southern shore, sky pale gold, the sea below hidden under a bank of white steam that has hung there for hundreds of years. The steam is lit from within in three separate colours, a red glow on the left, a violet glow in the middle, a teal glow on the right. Out of the steam rises the great three-headed beast: on the left a lion's head bigger than a city gate with its jaws opening wide and a throat of fire, in the middle a ram's head whose two horns spread like twin mountain ridges with violet lightning running between their tips, and on the right a long scaled serpent's tail lashing out of a rolling wave. The lion's jaws are the largest thing in the picture. Dropping down toward them in the near middle, wings folded back, comes a huge white winged horse, its wing-tips scorched black; on its back lies a young horseman diving with it, his body flat along its neck. Hipono has one side of his long pale-gold hair burnt white by lightning, his amber eyes are open and fixed on the lion's throat, his teeth are bared, and a broken bowstring is wound round his left wrist. He holds a long white-ash spear levelled before him, and at its tip a thick dark-grey lump of lead is lashed on with cord. Far below at the edge of the steam, tiny, in the lower right corner, a small wooden fishing boat tilts on the swell, and in it stands a slender sea-green-haired girl with both hands cupped to her mouth, singing; the serpent's wave is rising above her. Sparks, shreds of steam and a few white feathers streak past large and out of focus across the corners.

nodes.name: 断缰的羽
nodes.light: the cold blue of a long summer dusk, with the warm orange of scattered torches far away in the thorn field and in the lantern she holds
nodes.camera: low, at the edge of the thorn field, a little behind her shoulder, looking out over the thorns toward the far torches and the distant city wall; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk on the third day of the search, in a wide field of thorn bushes south of a small mountain city. In the far distance behind the field rise the dark city wall of grey stone and one gate tower, small, with a few lights in it. A tall white mountain stands behind the city in the fading sky. In the near left foreground, seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see one cheek and one winter-lake-blue eye, stands a girl of nineteen: long flaxen hair in two plaits coiled at the back of the head with a few short strands loose, a dark blue travelling cloak torn by thorns at the hem, a charcoal pencil still tucked in her sleeve. She is hoarse and tired; her mouth is open as if she has just called a name and is waiting. In her right hand, held low and heavy, hangs a golden horse halter with its cheek-straps and a ring, its reins cut clean through; beside her boot, caught on a thorn twig, lies a single white wing feather longer than a man's arm, its tip lifted a finger's width as if it still wants to rise. On the ground by the thorns at her feet there is a dark patch of dried blood and nothing else, no body. Out across the field, in a scattered line from near to far, small people stand holding torches raised toward the wall, among them a copper-braided dwarf woman and a sea-green-haired girl in a fisher's wrap, tiny and unmistakable by their hair. Thorn seeds and sparks drift large and out of focus across the corners.

notes: 这一段四个旅伴都没有死在2620到2621年以内：希波诺瞎了眼、断了腿，下落不明但不是死；洛温约2690年、汐拉约2690年、苔丝约2850年，都在这一段以外。所以 fates 和 deaths 是空的。
一幕画的是长曦月中旬那一夜王后到客房，希波诺把门推开站在门边请她回去，没有画第二天她哭诉的那一拍。
白马、泉边的断缰女人没有参考图，二幕只写白马不写女人，白马的样子照任务单“魔兽｜不落地的白马”。
三幕 beast 选 moon_011_1（第一阶，三张嘴都在），第二阶没用。
希波诺的立绘资料标的是失明以后的样子，who 里已写明这一段眼睛是睁着的、头发是纯金的，三幕头发被劈白半边，text 里写了。
